content: The autonomous-task-brain skill uses a standardized 5-stage closed-loop workflow for autonomous task management: perceive (scan sessions to identify new/repeat/failing tasks) → retrieve (search skills, history, memory systems, GitHub for solutions) → decide (pick execute/suggest/skip based on success rate, complexity, user prefs) → execute (build/modify skills, cron jobs, scripts or delegate subtasks) → review (log results, update knowledge base for future improvement).
